title: Nell Hums
checkpoint: Reception Autumn 2, week 3 — Learning — Phase 2: new sounds l, ll, ss
note_for_grown_ups: This book is about solving a problem by listening instead of looking — a nice one to try for real: close your eyes together and guess what you can hear.

pages.illustration: A small striped bug tucked out of sight under a leaf on a washing line post.
Nell the bee searching around the washing line post, unable to spot the hidden bug.

pages.text: Nell sat. Nell did not run.
pages.illustration: Nell the bee stopping completely still on a peg, listening hard instead of searching.
A faint humming sound shown as soft ripples coming from under a nearby leaf.
Nell the bee rising and flying straight towards the sound of the humming leaf.
Nell the bee finding the small striped bug under the leaf at last, both face to face.

pages.text: Nell is not sad. Nell has fun.
pages.illustration: Nell the bee and the little bug both looking cheerful together by the washing line.
